tips.text: Queue the Fieldron research as soon as the Energy Lab is built, then farm while the timers run.
Do Corpus Invasions when they show up; each one pays 3 built Fieldron, which skips a crafting step.
Build Fieldron from Fieldron Samples; the blueprint wants built Fieldron, not the samples.
Research Prova only as a prerequisite; you never build the Prova weapon for Dera.
Nobody complains about getting Dera; the research timers are the only real delay.
